spans.s:
Kauṇṭha-ravya is mentioned as a teacher in the Aitareya^1
and Śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyakas.^2
1) iii. 2, 2.
2) vii. 14; viii. 2.
Cf. Keith, Aitareya Āraṇyaka, 249.

Kauṇḍinya is mentioned as a pupil of Śāṇḍilya in the first
two Vaṃśas (lists of teachers) in the Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad.^1
See also Vidarbhīkauṇḍinya, and the following.
1) ii. 5, 20; iv. 5, 26 (Mādhyaṃdina = ii. 6, 1; iv. 6, 1, Kāṇva).

Kauṇḍinyāyana is mentioned in the first Vaṃśa (list of
teachers) of the Mādhyaṃdina recension of the Bṛhadāraṇyaka
Upaniṣad^1 as a pupil of Kauṇḍinya, pupil of Kauṇḍinya and
Āgniveśya; in the second^2 as a pupil of the two Kauṇḍinyas,
pupil of Kauṇḍinya and Āgniveśya. Neither Vaṃśa is of much
value.^3
1) ii. 5, 20.
2) iv. 5, 26.
3) Eggeling, Sacred Books of the East,
12, xxxiv.
